class.name: SortedList
class.brief_description: Keeps an Array sorted and reports the minimal updates.
class.description: SortedList is the port of [i]androidx.recyclerview.util.SortedList[/i]: it maintains a sorted array, inserts / removes items in the right place, and emits the minimal [b]SortedListCallback[/b] events so a RecyclerView only animates what changed. It uses a [b]SortedListCallback[/b] to compare and to decide whether content changed.

method.name: add
method.description: Inserts an item into its sorted position, emitting the minimal insert / change events.

method.name: add_all
method.description: Batches-inserts every item of an array into sorted position.

method.name: begin_batched_updates
method.description: Starts a batch; events are coalesced until [method end_batched_updates].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all items, emitting remove events.

method.name: end_batched_updates
method.description: Ends a batch and dispatches the coalesced events.

method.name: index_of
method.description: Returns the index of [code]item[/code], or -1 when absent.

method.name: recalculate_position_of_item_at
method.description: Re-sorts the item at [code]index[/code] and emits the minimal events.

method.name: replace_all
method.description: Replaces the whole list, diffing old vs new.

method.name: update_item_at
method.description: Updates the item at [code]index[/code] and emits change events.

members.member: The [b]SortedListCallback[/b] used to compare and diff items.
